rationale: With only $126.10 remaining in the daily loss budget and three short positions already open, adding further directional risk with 37 minutes left in the session is imprudent. Although GAP is breaking down to new intraday lows on expanding volume ($18.75 vs $18.68 low, well below VWAP at $19.14 and the 5m 9-EMA at $18.92), shorting right at the absolute low of a sharp 2-minute drop exposes the account to an immediate snap-back toward the $18.92 EMA, while buying against strong selling pressure and a weak broad market (SPY -1.84%) lacks structural support.
